items: Thank you to ichin23 for the first community contribution: Desk Buddy should now fill the whole screen on newer Kindles (firmware 5.16 and later)
Added: Exit to Kindle in the top-left menu takes you back to your books
Added: Flip screen, in the brightness panel and Settings › Screen › Orientation, for a Kindle standing the other way up
Added: Settings › Screen › Screen size: Compact, for larger text and tiles (on by itself on the older 600 × 800 Kindles)

Album covers look much better on the Kindle: twice as sharp (Settings › Music › Cover quality) and tuned for e-ink, so dark covers aren't muddy any more (the idea comes from Kindle Photo Prep by kuslota)
Added: Desk Buddy fits bigger Kindle screens (Paperwhite 3, 4 and 5, Signature Edition, Voyage, Oasis): everything is drawn at the screen's own resolution, so it fills the screen and stays sharp
Fixed: on the tour, the page dots no longer run into "Welcome to Desk Buddy"
